subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the shear wall between Sheet S-301 and Foundation

messages.text: The shear wall reinforcement shown in Sheet S-301 conflicts with a revised bar splice noted in Foundation Plan S-101. We need an urgent response on this; please treat it as time-sensitive. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding any current pour. We need a response within one business day, if at all possible.
Proceed with a revised bar splice per Foundation Plan S-101; Sheet S-301 is superseded. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding any current pour.
To confirm before we place concrete: does this direction -- a revised bar splice -- apply at every shear wall on this level, not just the one called out in Sheet S-301?
